title: The resolved-conflict check misses a dropped method or a dropped top-level assignment
goal: kg_merge.lost_definitions (behind `kbgit.py lost-definitions FILE`, which /kb-git-sync and /kb-item run on a resolved _tools/*.py conflict in place of their inline python -c) compares every definition both sides added, a class's methods (as Class.method) and top-level assignments included, not only top-level def and class names, so a resolution that drops one side's method added to a shared class prints it as lost and exits 1; both skills name the command (ST-ikxgirce's inline check moves into the tool). Found by the SP-wmukiu3s review.

run:
import sys;sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import kg_merge;f=getattr(kg_merge,'lost_definitions',None);base='class C:
    def a(self):
        pass
';ours=base+'    def b(self):
        pass
';theirs=base+'    def c(self):
        pass
';sys.exit(1 if f is None or 'C.c' not in f(base,ours,theirs,ours) else 0)
